guides.title: Client
guides.description: Discover the daemon, verify its identity, and get a connected client.

sections.title: Connect
sections.text: Construct a connected instance. Discovery checks an explicit address, then `COMPOZY_URL`, then the `daemon.json` in the daemon home, then `http://127.0.0.1:2123`. A non-browser local process does not need an app token.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: Select a daemon ahead of environment and local discovery.

fields.name: token
fields.description: App token sent as a bearer token. Node also reads `COMPOZY_APP_TOKEN`.

fields.name: home
fields.description: Daemon home ahead of `COMPOZY_HOME` and `~/.compozy`.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Connect timeout. Defaults to 5000.

fields.name: fetch
fields.description: A fetch implementation for runtimes that do not provide one.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: Sent as `X-Compozy-Client-ID`. Defaults to `sdk-ts`.

fields.name: onVersionMismatch
fields.description: Called when the daemon major or minor version differs. The client still connects.

fields.name: WithBaseURL
fields.description: Selects an HTTP origin ahead of environment and local discovery.

fields.name: WithSocket
fields.description: Selects the unix socket tried before the home directory's TCP record.

fields.name: WithHome
fields.description: Selects the daemon home ahead of `COMPOZY_HOME` and `~/.compozy`.

fields.name: WithToken
fields.description: Sets the bearer token sent on every request.

fields.name: WithHTTPClient
fields.description: Uses a caller-configured HTTP client without mutating it.

fields.name: WithLogger
fields.description: Selects the logger for daemon version warnings.

fields.name: WithClientID
fields.description: Sets the `X-Compozy-Client-ID` header. Defaults to `sdk-go`.

sections.title: Daemon identity
sections.text: The identity the daemon reported when the client connected.

sections.title: Start a private daemon
sections.text: The Node-only `@compozy/client/node` entry starts a daemon when that home has none. `close({ stopDaemon: true })` stops only the daemon this client started. The binary lookup is `binaryPath`, `COMPOZY_BIN`, installed `@compozy/cli`, then `PATH`.

fields.name: home
fields.description: The private daemon home.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Start timeout. Defaults to 30000.

fields.name: binaryPath
fields.description: Path to the `compozy` binary.

guides.title: Prompt
guides.description: Send input to a session and read the reply as a stream or an accepted receipt.

sections.title: Send a prompt
sections.text: Check the reply kind: a stream carries chunks, an accepted result carries `status`, `delivery`, and `queue_position` instead. A prompt stream does not reconnect. Aborting or closing it only stops your reader: the agent keeps running.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Use `queue` when a session may be busy. `interrupt` and `steer` replace the active turn according to the session's admission rules.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: Supply the same key when retrying the same input to preserve its message identity.

fields.name: signal
fields.description: Stops reading without canceling the daemon's turn.

go.signature: func (c *Client) Prompt(ctx context.Context, in PromptInput) (*PromptStream, error)

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: A busy-input mode: `queue`, `interrupt` or `steer`.

sections.title: Read the reply
sections.text: Inspect whether the input was accepted before reading chunks.

sections.title: Forward the stream from a server route
sections.text: Use `promptResponse()` in a server route to forward the AI SDK UI message stream unchanged.

guides.title: Events
guides.description: Follow server-sent event operations, with reconnection handled for you.

sections.title: Subscribe to a stream
sections.text: The SDK reconnects dropped event streams and 5xx responses with `Last-Event-ID`, starting at 500 ms and doubling to 8 seconds. It stops after 20 consecutive failed reconnects; a received frame resets that count. A 4xx stops immediately. Go streams instead return `io.EOF` when the server closes them.

ts.signature:
compozy.events<Id extends SseOperationId>(
  operationId: Id,
  options: SseOptions<Id>
): AsyncIterable<StreamEvent<SseFrame<Id>>>

fields.name: path
fields.description: The operation's path parameters.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The operation's query parameters.

fields.name: signal
fields.description: Abort the signal to end the subscription.

go.signature:
func (s *Stream[T]) Next() (Frame[T], error)
func (s *Stream[T]) Close() error

guides.title: Errors
guides.description: What the clients raise when the daemon is away, misconfigured, or returns an error.

sections.title: API errors
sections.text: The daemon returned an HTTP error. Secrets and request headers are never retained.

sections.title: Connection and stream errors
sections.text: Connection failures raise `CompozyUnavailableError`; invalid discovery configuration raises `CompozyConfigError`. Malformed event data raises `CompozyStreamError`.

ts.signature:
class CompozyUnavailableError extends Error
class CompozyConfigError extends Error
class CompozyStreamError extends Error
class CompozyBinaryNotFoundError extends Error
